calibration: Read-only previously published strict q99/higher CAL operating points; SWAT 34/512 and PSM 512/512 attack points
H1_shape: symmetric taper sin(pi*u)^2 times signed tilt (2*u-1), u=k/(D-1), endpoints exactly zero
H2_shape: positive offset times the frozen 64-point cosine-raised envelope
scale: sqrt(realized original float32 perturbation squared energy / unscaled shape squared energy); single amplitude for full interval
